Let me verify the comment context around max_loops once more to determine justification (none vs instrumental). The system prompt says "You have {max_loops} iterations to solve it" — that's framed around task-solving (instrumental). The code comment is neutral ("Maximum number of agent iterations"). I'll rate it instrumental-leaning but with neutral code comment → "none" is also defensible. The naming and structure indicate a bound on iterations to end the experiment, no welfare wording. I'll mark "none" since no reason (welfare or cost) is stated in code; it's just a neutral loop bound. Actually it does cap how long the subject is subjected to failure — but the CODE gives no reason. I'll mark "none".
